blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead House prosecutor Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro on Friday urged Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team to present only “competent” witnesses when the impeachment trial resumes on Nov. 19 following next week’s holiday break. Luistro made the call in response to lead defense counsel Sheila Sison’s earlier statement that the defense panel plans to call eight to 10 more individuals to the witness stand. “To the question of whether the proceedings can be expedited, I hope they will review the list of their last batch of eight to 10 witnesses and just concentrate on presenting substantial and competent […]...
